visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long black hair and a blue headband is standing indoors. She is wearing a black and white houndstooth patterned jacket over a white top. She holds a green ceramic cup with blue and yellow accents, pointing to its interior which contains a small sculpted creature. The background consists of a colorful mural and shelves filled with various small pottery figures. (2) A close-up shot transitions to the inside of the green cup, revealing a small, bug-eyed creature sculpted at the bottom. The camera then flips the cup over to show a small circular hole in the center of the brown, unglazed base. (3) The woman is seen pouring water from a gold-colored metallic kettle into the green cup. She holds the cup over a clear plastic container. The water level reaches about halfway, and she shows the bottom of the cup to confirm no water is leaking. (4) The woman continues talking, pointing her finger upward as if explaining a rule. She then pours more water until the cup is nearly full. Immediately, a steady stream of water begins to pour out from the hole at the bottom of the cup into the plastic bin below. (5) The camera shows a top-down view of the water level inside the cup dropping rapidly as it drains. The woman observes the process. (6) A technical cut shows a close-up of a printed document titled 'A WONDER TEACUP,' which includes illustrations of colorful creatures and text in English and Traditional Chinese explaining the 'Justice Cup' history. (7) The video concludes with the woman back on screen, gesturing towards the draining cup and speaking directly to the camera, emphasizing the cup's lesson about greed.
